description: List all welcome offers with spend progress, deadline urgency, and bonus valuations. Filter by status, owner, deadline window, or origin (signup vs retention). Each returned offer includes `origin` and `source_event_id` — retention-origin offers link back to the CardEvent retention_offer row that spawned them.

expiring_within_days.description: Only offers with deadlines within N days

origin.description: Filter by origin — 'signup' for traditional welcome offers, 'retention' for bonuses granted during retention calls

name: list_welcome_offers
